docs.title: Overview
docs.body:
Design keeps the app's design system: the tokens, components and brand every screen is drawn with. Other layers draw with copies of it.

**Start here**

1. [Charter](#doc/charter).
2. [Information](#info): what the design system contains, and who holds copies.
3. The method for your task: [Tokens](#doc/tokens-method), [Components](#doc/component-method) or [Brand](#doc/brand-method).

docs.title: Charter
docs.body:
## Purpose

Keep one design system for the app, so every screen looks like the same product.

## Contents and scope

Tokens, components and brand assets. Page layouts belong to Pages; built styles belong to Code.

docs.title: Tokens method
docs.body: Edit tokens as a draft against the live preview, then save one revision of the whole set with a note saying what changed and why. Keep each colour role at WCAG AA against its pair in both light and dark mode.

docs.title: Components method
docs.body: A component is a contract: its name, props, variants and the states it must render. Change the contract deliberately; copies in other layers follow it.

docs.title: Brand method
docs.body: The name and mark come first; imagery follows the mark's colours. Every asset has alt text and a usage note.

docs.title: Tokens
docs.body:
Two panes: the token tree and a live preview. Change raw values on the preview; change what a role points at in the tree.

**Edits:** [Tokens](#node/tokens).

docs.title: Docs
docs.body:
Usage guidance written for designers and builders, such as when to use a card or a list.

information.title: Tokens
information.intent: Colour roles, type, spacing and corners: the values every screen is styled with.
information.body:
One token set per project, saved as whole revisions. Roles (primary, surface, on-surface…) point at palette values; each role has a light and a dark value.

The set describes groups — colour roles, type scale, spacing, corners — but they are parts of one record, not separate nodes.

fields: Role → palette value, light and dark
Scale steps: size, weight, line height

information.title: Components
information.intent: The building blocks screens are made of, with their props, variants and states.
information.body: Each component is a contract other layers build against.

information.title: Brand assets
information.intent: The app's name, mark and approved imagery.
information.body: Each asset has a role (name, mark, imagery), a file, alt text and a usage note.

information.title: Usage docs
information.intent: Guidance on when and how to use each part of the system.
information.body: Short Markdown pages, one per topic.
